seo_title: Massachusetts Scholarships for High School Seniors
seo_description: Explore 43 scholarships for high school seniors in Massachusetts with awards from $500 to $40,000. Check deadlines and requirements.
intro: Navigating the financial landscape for college can be challenging, especially for high school seniors in Massachusetts. With 43 scholarships available in this category, students can find a variety of funding opportunities to support their educational goals. Award sizes vary significantly, ranging from $500 to $40,000, and many listings have no essay requirement, making them accessible for a wider range of applicants. Be sure to check individual deadlines, as they can differ across listings.

faq.question: What types of scholarships are available for high school seniors in Massachusetts?
faq.answer: There are 43 scholarships listed for high school seniors in Massachusetts, covering a range of categories including education, community, STEM, biology, and medicine. Each scholarship may have different eligibility criteria and focus areas, so it's beneficial to review the details of each listing.

faq.question: Are there any essay requirements for these scholarships?
faq.answer: Most of the scholarships in this listing do not require essays, but it's important to check each individual scholarship for specific requirements. While many listings are lighter on application demands, verifying the details will ensure you meet all necessary criteria.

faq.question: How can I find out the deadlines for these scholarships?
faq.answer: All 43 scholarships have deadlines, but they vary from listing to listing. Some deadlines are approaching within the next 45 days, so it's advisable to check the specific dates for each scholarship promptly to ensure you don't miss any opportunities.

faq.question: What is the range of award amounts for these scholarships?
faq.answer: The award amounts for scholarships in this category vary significantly, with some offering as little as $500 and others up to $40,000. Each scholarship has its own funding level, so reviewing the details will provide clarity on what you might expect.
